selected_item.original_deferral_reason: Discovered April 2026 late in R10 cycle; required regime gate design while K275 still in-flight (K303)

March 2026 flip to negative carry is not temporary compression but regime shift requiring architectural decision. 30-day BTC FR avg <-0.001% most negative since 2023. K275 architected for positive carry; negative carry inverts logic entirely (shorts collect instead of longs pay).

decision: DEFER with explicit trigger + conditional ACT window
decision_rationale: Root cause identified but regime change is recent (March 2026)
K275 already live with -3.55 Sh; immediate redesign during negative regime carries whipsaw risk
Better to observe trigger: if carry normalizes, gate never activates; if persists, gate saves capital
Conditional ACT window provides clear decision point
